spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact getPathData() and getPathData({normalize:true}) on the browser's own parse of the d attribute; verified flagged output keeps relative letters, expands implicit repeated commands (7 segments M L m l...) and normalizes arcs to multiple C.

interactive.rationale: Preset select, editable d textarea (debounced) and Read button rebuild both tables; focus/hover on a row highlights that segment on the drawing.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the raw vs normalized comparison and segment highlight; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers shorthand, arcs, two subpaths, implicit commands and a mid-string parse error (valid prefix); does not cover exotic number syntax (exponents, '.5.5') explicitly.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 plus the SVG Paths spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: Backs get-path-data-segments, normalize-absolute-mlcz and empty-path-empty-array; flagged run 8/10 pass with the 2 fails being getPathSegmentAtLength (absent in 153).

runtime_evidence.rationale: No chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment: verified with Playwright headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12, default flags and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; all presets + typed input + row focus exercised, 0px overflow; the only console entry is the browser's own d-attribute parse error when the user picks the deliberately broken preset (labelled as expected in the option text). Not run in a Chrome build that has the API on by default.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts svgpd-inspect-native (normalized output only M/L/C/Z) or svgpd-inspect-fallback-labelled (fallback source + normalize unavailable).

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared path-demo.css + small inline blocks); every button override sets both background and color; status chips use emerald-dark/rose on paper/stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select/textarea, polite debounced summary, captioned tables in focusable labelled regions, table rows focusable for keyboard highlight, svg role=img with title.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Tables and controls fit at 360px (0px overflow, screenshot read); textarea and select are 44px+ targets.

openQuestions.title: Add a number-syntax torture preset
openQuestions.detail: Add a preset with exponents, '.5.5' adjacency, compact arc flags ('a1 1 0 00 1 1') and comma/whitespace variants, and compare native vs fallback parser output so the fallback's limits are visible.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify in a Chrome build with SVGPathDataAPI enabled by default
openQuestions.detail: Verified only behind --enable-blink-features in Chrome 153; re-run in Chrome 159 / Canary once the feature flips to stable status, and in Firefox 137+.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use polite live regions for standard status updates, debounce frequently-changing regions, use role=img + title for non-decorative inline SVG, and provide data tables as alternatives for visual graphics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status lines are role=status/aria-live=polite and debounced (250-400ms) where driven by sliders/typing/drag; each SVG has role=img (or role=group for the editor) with a <title>; segment data is always also shown as text/table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports, set min-width:0 on grid children, and wrap long unbreakable tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared path-demo.css: .split/.cases grids collapse to one column below 640-860px, min-width:0 on stage children, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic <table>/<caption>/<th scope> inside a focusable, labelled role=region scroll wrapper with sticky headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Segment tables use caption + th scope=col/row inside .scroll-box (tabindex=0, role=region, aria-labelledby the caption) with sticky thead; stacked-card transformation not needed because tables are 3 short columns.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in a cloud session without chrome-devtools-mcp; evidence is Playwright headless Chrome 153 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI.
